import json,urllib.request
ids=[('Growth','11e3962c-57fb-4218-94cd-ee9ba7c25a4c'),('Native','b1314ed6-5b22-4cbf-8865-e044b4bd683f')]
out=[]
for label,aid in ids:
 u='http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments/'+aid+'/recover-unsent-draft'
 try:
  d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(u,timeout=12).read().decode('utf-8'))
  out.append({'label':label,**d})
 except Exception as e:
  out.append({'label':label,'error':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)})
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')))
